system.description:
Arcanists given a precious gift of magical prowess, sorcerers can tap into their own inner reserves to provide more Mana for casting.


Iconic Sorcerers

• Yennefer, The Witcher

• Elsa, Frozen

• Ganondorf, The Legend of Zelda

• Storm, X-Men


Playing Sorcerer

The sorcerer is a squishy blaster focused on Casting Spells for instant burst damage. You should stay in safety to Cast.


Action: Cast

Move: Backline


Training: Influence

features.name: Glamour
features.description:
You can Cast Spells using Influence.


Spells: You learn 4 Spells. You learn 1 other Spell every 2 Levels hereafter.


Mana: Your Max Mana is equal to (4 × your Level), and the highest amount of Mana you can spend to Cast a Spell is equal to (2 + your Level).

features.name: Tap
features.description: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-app.perks.Item.eDxdbBsCNsDdTsG0]{Vehement Magic Perk}, and you can spend your HP as Mana, which also reduces your Max HP by the same amount until you Rest. If you die from this reduction, the Cast still resolves and your body is vaporized.

features.name: Quickening
features.description:
You can skip your Move to Cast a Spell.


You can spend 0 Mana to upcast this Spell, but the amount of Mana you can spend to upcast it increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Spell Slinger
features.description: The damage die of your Spells is one size larger.

features.name: Spell Slinger
features.description: The roll required for you to Crit on Cast Checks and Saves against Casts is reduced by 1, and is reduced by 1 more every 4 Levels hereafter.
